title: Image Viewer for GitHub
imageAlt: Image Viewer for GitHub store graphic: a screenshot from a pull request open in a floating viewer, with steps to click an image, move with the arrow keys, and close with Esc
description: *Image Viewer for GitHub* is a **Chrome extension, published on the Chrome Web Store**. On GitHub pull requests and issues, a click on an image opens it in a **floating viewer** on top of the page, instead of a new tab.
The arrow keys move between the images of that one comment. The viewer shows the position, such as 3 / 7, the **alt text**, the size and the format. Zoom with the mouse wheel, and close with Esc.
It asks for no permission, and nothing leaves the browser.
